buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C SR, DIVISIONAL FINANCE MANAGER - BHAVNAGAR PARA . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of SR. DIVISIONAL FINANCE MANAGER BHAVNAGAR PARA A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 6. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any.

7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses A. ELIGIBILITY & SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS 1. Vehicle Eligibility: The vehicle offered must be roadworthy and posse ss a valid registration certificate dated 01.10.2026 or later. Offers indicat ing older registrations may be rejected. 2. Availability at Tender Opening: The offered vehicle must be readily available with the tenderer at the time of tender opening. In case the con tractor is unable to supply the vehicle within 15 (fifteen) days from the d ate of issue of the Letter of Acceptance, a request for along with a valid dealer delivery assurance certificate. Grant of such extension shall be at the sole discretion of the Sr. Divisional Commercial Manager, Bhavnagar Division. 3. Blacklisting Affidavit: A notarized affidavit (Annexure-G) confirming t hat the firm is not blacklisted or debarred by any Government Departme nt, PSU, or Local Body must be submitted. Non-submission may result in rejection. 4. Bankruptcy/ Insolvency: The tenderer must not have suffered bankru ptcy or insolvency during the last four (04) years. A self-undertaking to t his effect shall be submitted. 5. Documents to be Uploaded: The tenderer shall upload the following properly indexed and numbered annexures: · Registration under Shop & Establishment Act / Partnership Act / Co mpanies Act / Co-operative Society Act. · Permanent Account Number (PAN) and copy of PAN Card. · Bank details including name of bank, branch address, IFSC, MICR c ode, and cancelled cheque. · Proof of business address and contact details (mobile, landline, em ail, fax). · Goods & Services Tax (GST) registration number · Annexure-A: Certificate of no relative being an employee of Weste rn Railway · Annexure-B: Bidder Details · Annexure-C: List of Vehicles Owned available with the firm · Annexure-E: Notarized affidavit for Self-certification of documents · Annexure-G: Notarized affidavit for blacklisting status of the bidde r · Annexure-H: Bidder’s bank details/ mandate

6. Tender Validity & EMD: The offer shall remain valid for 60 (sixty) day s from the date of tender opening. Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) of the s uccessful tenderer shall be adjusted towards the Security Deposit. No int erest shall be payable on EMD. 7. Forfeiture of EMD: EMD shall be forfeited if the tenderer— o Withdraws the offer during the validity period, or o Fails to furnish the performance guarantee, commence the work, or execute the contract after issue of LOA. 8. Conditional Offers: Conditional or incomplete tenders are liable to be summarily rejected without assigning any reason. 9. Right of Railway Administration: The Railway Administration reserve s the right to accept or reject any or all offers without assigning reasons whatsoever. No claim or cause of action shall lie against the Railway in t his regard. 10. Portal Updates: Tenderers are advised to keep themselves updated w ith any corrigendum or clarification uploaded on https://www.gem.gov .in prior to submission. B. VEHICLE OWNERSHIP, SUPPLY & IDENTIFICATION 11. Ownership & Supply Timeline: The vehicle must be owned by the te nderer and supplied within 15 days from the date of issue of LOA. Failur e to supply within this period may lead to termination unless an extensi on is granted based on a valid dealer delivery assurance letter. 12. Substitution: In case of technical issues, a similar or higher-class vehi cle may be deployed only with prior written approval of the competent a uthority. 13. Vehicle Identification: The vehicle shall display a “GOVT. OF INDIA” placard permanently fixed on the front, clearly visible from a minimum distance of 5 metres. 14. Registration & Compliance: The vehicle shall always comply with th e Motor Vehicles Act and Rules, and possess valid RC, insurance, fitness, and pollution certificates. C. SERVICE AVAILABILITY & OPERATIONS 15. 24×7 Availability: The vehicle shall remain available on a round-the-c lock (24×7) basis throughout the contract period. If withdrawn for servic ing/repair, a suitable replacement shall be provided immediately. 16. Reporting & Control: The vehicle/driver shall report to the Commerci al Office, Bhavnagar Para, or any location nominated by the competent authority.

17. Duty Shifts: Drivers shall be deployed at any point of time in 12-hours each day. any change in duty timing or deployment shall be made only with the prior approval of the competent authority. 18. Duty Hours & Kilometres Accounting: Duty hours and kilometres s hall be counted from/to the officer’s residence at reporting and release points. The decision of the officer-in-charge shall be final in case of disp ute. 19. Road/Worksite Access: The vehicle shall operate on all road types, in cluding kutcha/embankment/worksite roads, without refusal or excuse r egarding road conditions. 20. Fuel Readiness: The driver shall always ensure adequate fuel. Fuel sh ortage during duty shall attract a penalty of ₹500 per instance. 21. Instrumentation: Odometer, speedometer, and all instruments shall b e fully functional. In case of failure, the contractor shall repair or replace the vehicle immediately at own cost. The officer’s recorded reading shal l be final during downtime. 22. Communication: The contractor shall provide functional mobile numb ers of responsible personnel and a dedicated phone for the driver attached to the vehicle, ensuring uninterrupted connectivity. D. PERSONNEL (DRIVERS/STAFF) 23. Manpower: A qualified and licensed drivers shall be deployed. Each m ust have valid DL, biodata, and police verification. 24. Identification & Entry: All personnel must carry photo ID cards counte rsigned by Railway authorities. Copies shall be submitted for record. 25. Medical Fitness: All staff must be physically and mentally fit. Any driv er declared unfit by Railway’s medical examiner shall be replaced immed iately. 26. Employment Status: The contractor’s staff shall remain its own emplo yees. No claim of employment with Indian Railways shall be entertained. 27. Weekly Rest & Residence Proximity: Drivers shall be granted one w eekly rest (normally Sunday) and should reside within 5 km of Bhavnaga r Para Office for quick mobilization. 28. Conduct & Route Knowledge: Drivers must possess adequate knowle dge of Gujarat roads and maintain disciplined, courteous behaviour. Misc onduct will invite penalties and possible removal. E. INSURANCE, SAFETY & LIABILITY 29. First Aid: The contractor shall maintain a First Aid Kit with sterilized cot ton, bandages, and antiseptics in the deployed vehicle itself under a res ponsible person’s charge during working hours. 30. ESI/Employees’ Compensation: All staff must be covered under ESI o

r the Employees’ Compensation Act, as applicable. Documentary proof s hall be submitted to Railway. 31. Third-Party Liability: The contractor shall maintain Third-Party Insura nce jointly in the name of Indian Railways and the contractor to cover los ses, damages, injuries, or deaths arising from performance. 32. Accidents/Damages: The contractor shall bear full responsibility for all accidents or damages to vehicle, Railway property, personnel, or others, and indemnify Railways against all claims and costs. 33. On-Call Failure: Failure to provide an immediate replacement vehicle ( except for flat tyre/fuel shortage) will attract a ₹500 penalty per instance plus recovery of alternate transport costs. Repeated failures may lead to termination or blacklisting. F. LEGAL & STATUTORY COMPLIANCE 34. Documents in Vehicle: RC, Insurance, PUC, Tax, and Permit receipts s hall remain valid and available in the vehicle at all times. 35. Labour Law Compliance: The contractor shall comply with all labour l aws, including: o Minimum Wages Act (State/Central rates, whichever is higher). o EPF deposit for eligible employees. o ESI Act, 1948. o Overtime paid at double ordinary rate for >9 hrs/day or >48 hrs/w eek. o Wage Slips issued at least one day before disbursement. o Final payment made within 48 hours of contract termination or w ork completion. 36. Suspicious Activity Reporting: Any suspicious, unlawful, or anti-soci al activity shall be immediately reported to Railway officials or local law enforcement. G. BOOKING, AVAILABILITY & PENALTIES 37. Duty Assignment: Duty will be assigned by the nominated Commercia l supervisors through the driver’s registered mobile number. 38. Non-availability of Vehicle/Driver: If the hired vehicle/Driver is not made available on any day, a penalty of ₹1,000/- per day shall be impos ed in addition to deduction of the proportional daily hire charge for that day. Repeated lapses may attract penalties up to ₹5,000 per instance. 39. Punctuality: Drivers must report promptly and complete post-duty retu rn procedures at Commercial Office without delay.

H. COMMERCIALS & RATES 40. Fuel Price Variation: No revision in rates shall be allowed during the c ontract period due to fluctuation in fuel or consumable prices. 41. Monthly Running Cap: The maximum permissible running per month shall be 2,500 km for the Commercial Office, Bhavnagar Para. I. DISCRETION & JURISDICTION 42. Breach of Obligations: In case of breach of any contractual obligation , the defaulting party shall fully indemnify the other and bear all monetar y losses arising therefrom. 43. Use of Name: The contractor shall not use the name or emblem of Indi an Railways for advertisement or credit purposes. 44. Assignment/Subletting: The contract or any part thereof shall not be assigned, transferred, mortgaged, or sublet. 45. Notice: All notices shall be in English or Hindi, sent by Registered Post A/D, courier, or hand delivery to the address mentioned in the contract. 46. Jurisdiction: All legal disputes arising out of this contract shall be subje ct to the exclusive jurisdiction of Bhavnagar Courts only. J. PERFORMANCE GUARANTEE, DAMAGES & RISK LIABILITY 1. Performance Guarantee (PG) 1.1 The Contractor shall furnish a Performance Guarantee (PG) equivalent to fi ve percent (5%) of the total contract value, issued by a Scheduled Comme rcial Bank (including Scheduled Commercial Foreign Banks) operating in In dia, and in the same currency in which the Contract Price is payable. 1.2 The Performance Guarantee shall be submitted within thirty (30) days fro m the date of receipt of the Letter of Acceptance (LOA). The PG shall be va lid for a period of six (06) months beyond the completion of the contract p eriod. 1.3 The Performance Guarantee may be progressively reduced proportionately for the balance period upon satisfactory completion of each contractual ye ar, as decided by the competent authority. 2. Extension of Time for Submission of PG 2.1 Extension of time for submission of the Performance Guarantee beyond 30 (thirty) days and up to the actual date of submission may be granted by th e authority competent to sign the agreement. 2.2 In such cases, a penal interest of 15% per annum shall be levied for the delay beyond 30 days (i.e., from the 31st day after the date of issue of

LOA). 2.3 If the contractor fails to submit the PG within 60 days from the date of issu e of LOA, a notice shall be served requiring immediate submission, allowin g time up to a maximum of 90 days from the date of LOA. 2.4 Failure to submit the PG even after 90 days shall result in termination of th e contract, forfeiture of EMD and all dues, and debarment from participatin g in the re-tender for the same work. If the 60th day happens to be a bank holiday or office closure, the next working day shall be considered the final due date. 2.5 The decision of the authority competent to sign the contract shall be final and binding in case of any dispute or interpretation regarding the submissi on of the PG. 3. Variation in Contract Value and Corresponding PG Adjustment 3.1 The value of the Performance Guarantee shall remain unchanged for variations up to 25% (increase or decrease) in the contract value. 3.2 If the contract value increases by more than 25%, the contractor shall furn ish an additional PG equivalent to 10% of the increased value, deposited in four equal instalments. 3.3 In case of a decrease in contract value, a corresponding 10% of the reduce d amount shall be refunded to the contractor, ensuring Railway’s interest i s fully safeguarded. 3.4 The applicable Performance Guarantee shall always cover the revised cont ract value considering all variations up to the date of completion. 4. Forfeiture of Performance Guarantee 4.1 The Performance Guarantee shall be forfeited under the following conditio ns: If the penalties imposed exceed 50% of the applicable maximum penalty, 25% of the PG shall be forfeited. If the penalties imposed exceed 75% of the applicable maximum penalty, 50% of the PG shall be forfeited. 4.2 The PG shall be encashed only after the completion of the contract, unless otherwise warranted due to failure or rescission. 4.3 Whenever the contract is rescinded, the Performance Guarantee shall be f ully forfeited, and the balance work/services shall be carried out independe ntly without risk and cost to the failed contractor. The failed contractor shal l be debarred for a period of two (02) years from the date of rescindment f rom participating in any future bids for similar services. In case the contractor is a partnership firm, each partner/member of such f irm shall also be debarred individually for the same period. 5. Release of Performance Guarantee

5.1 The PG shall be released only after: Physical completion of services/work. Issue of a Completion Certificate by the competent authority certifying satisfa ctory performance; and Submission of a “No Claim Certificate” by the contractor along with passing of the final bill. 5.2 In cases where the contract stipulates a warranty or maintenance clause, 25% of the PG shall be retained until expiry of the warranty/maintenance period and certification thereof by the concerned officer. 6. Invocation of Performance Guarantee 6.1 The Railway Administration shall not make a claim under the PG except for amo unts to which the President of India is entitled under the contract, notwithstandi ng any other provisions. 6.2 The PG may be invoked in the following events: a) Failure of the contractor to extend the validity of the PG as required. b) Failure of the contractor to pay any dues or penalties determined under the c ontract within 30 days of notice by the Manager. c) Determination or rescission of the contract under the provisions of the GCC, i n which case the PG shall be forfeited in full and shall become the absolute pro perty of the President of India. 7. Damage to Railway Property or Private Life and Property 7.1 The contractor shall be responsible for all risks associated with the execution of work or service and shall make good, at his own cost, all losses or damages wh ether to: Railway property or works. Lives, persons, or property of others; or Any damage arising due to trespass, negligence, or omission by the contractor or his employees. 7.2 If the Railway is required to make good any costs, losses, damages, or compens ation (including payments under the Workmen’s Compensation Act or any other statutory provisions), the same shall be recovered in full of the contractor, alon g with any legal or incidental expenses incurred by the Railway. 7.3 The Railway shall have the right to defend, pay, or compromise any such claims or threatened legal proceedings in anticipation thereof, and all associated costs shall be borne by the contractor. The propriety of such action or expenses shall be final and binding upon the contractor. . 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA Text Clause(s)
